component.name: zd1
component.summary: Install, update and set up a B&W Zeppelin Air running zd1

description.p: The zd1 web page in a window of its own: the speaker over USB with nothing to allow first, and on the network, found by itself. It installs zd1 on a Zeppelin Air from its bootloader, updates it, sets up its Wi-Fi and its receivers, and goes back to B&W's software.
